commit_message: Complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio browser validation
pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first-release visual validation from current main while preserving the ADR0157 AI Studio runtime-debug changes. Adds deterministic host-owned Remote fixture state, captures the production companion in Microsoft Edge at desktop/narrow/mobile widths, preserves the full-clippy test-module ordering fix, and saves helper Editor stdout/stderr as Visual artifacts so startup failures have actionable root-cause evidence.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because scripts/ci changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the generated Remote AI Studio screenshots.
